facebookresearch_coconut/dataset.py.get_cot_latent_dataset: create a chain-of-thought dataset with latent tokens and skip steps for scheduled stage training

facebookresearch_coconut/utils.py.test_set_seed_function: test the set_seed function to verify deterministic behavior across random, numpy, and torch
